name: Continual World
description: A benchmark for continual reinforcement learning in robotics, consisting of diverse robotic tasks built on Meta-World. It aims to evaluate continual learning methods focusing on forward transfer, catastrophic forgetting, and computational efficiency.
typical_sota_score: Varies widely by task and metric; reported task-success/forward-transfer rates typically range from ~40% to ~90% depending on the task and method
reputation: A well-known continual reinforcement learning benchmark built on Meta-World and commonly used to study catastrophic forgetting and transfer in robotics.
notes: Provides a computationally inexpensive and realistic benchmark for continual RL with robotic tasks.
